sn46.52:1.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthim piṇḍaya pavisiṃsu || || 3.
sn46.52:1.2: Atha kho tesam bhikkhūnam etad ahosi || ||
sn46.52:1.3: Atippago kho tāva Sāvatthiyam piṇḍāya carituṃ ||
sn46.52:1.4: yaṃ nuna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkamayyemā ti || || 4.
sn46.52:2.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu ||
sn46.52:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etad avocuṃ || || 5.
sn46.52:3.1: Samaṇo āvuso Gotamo sāvakānam evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ||
sn46.52:3.2: Etha tumhe bhikkhave pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe sattabojjhaṅge yathābhūtam bhāvethāti || ||
sn46.52:3.3: Mayam pi kho āvuso sāvakānam evaṃ dhammaṃ desema ||
sn46.52:3.4: Etha tumhe āvuso pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe satta bojjhaṅge yathābhūtam bhāvethāti || ||
sn46.52:3.5: Idha no āvuso ko viseso ko adhippāyo || kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā Gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yadidam dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanam anusāsaniyā vā anusāsanin ti || || 6.
sn46.52:4.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbajakānam bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃsu nappaṭikkosiṃsu ||
sn46.52:4.3: Bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmāti || || 7.
sn46.52:4.4: Atha kho te bhikkhū Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍaya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapatikkantā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 8. Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn46.52:5.1: Idha mayam bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthim piṇḍaya pavisimha ||
sn46.52:5.2: tesaṃ no bhante amhākam etad ahosi ||
sn46.52:5.3: Atippago kho tāva Sāvatthiyam piṇḍāya carituṃ
sn46.52:5.4: yaṃ nuna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmā ti || ||
sn46.52:5.5: Atha kho mayam bhante yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkamimha || upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodimha ||
sn46.52:5.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdimha || Ekam antaṃ nisinne kho amhe bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etad avocuṃ || || 9.
sn46.52:6.1: Samaṇo āvuso Gotamo sāvakānam evam dhammaṃ deseti
sn46.52:7.1: Atha kho mayam bhante tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandimha na paṭikkosimha || anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyasanā pakkamimha
sn46.52:7.2: Bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa attham ājānissāmāti || || 11.
sn46.52:8.1: Evaṃ vādino bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacaniyā || ||
sn46.52:8.2: Atthi panāvuso pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma pañca nīvaraṇā dasa honti || satta bojjhaṅgā catuddasā ti || ||
sn46.52:8.3: Evam puṭṭhā bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti uttariñca vighātam āpajjissanti || || 12.
sn46.52:8.6: nāhaṃ tam bhikkhave passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sasamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo imesam pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittam ārādheyya aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā || || 13.
sn46.52:9.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma pañca nīvaraṇā dasa honti || || 14.
sn46.52:9.2: Yad api bhikkhave ajjhattam kāmacchando tad api nīvaraṇaṃ || yad api bahiddhā kāmacchando tad api nīvaraṇaṃ
sn46.52:9.3: Kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ ti iti hidam uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 15.
sn46.52:9.4: Yad api bhikkhave ajjhattam byāpādo tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ || yad api bahiddhā byāpādo tad api nīvaraṇam
sn46.52:9.5: Byāpādanīvaraṇan ti iti hidam uddesaṃ āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 16.
sn46.52:9.6: Yad api bhikkhave thīnaṃ tad api nīvaraṇam || yadapi middham tad api nīvaranaṃ
sn46.52:9.7: Thīnamiddhanīvaraṇam ti iti hidam uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 17.
sn46.52:9.8: Yad api bhikkhave uddhaccaṃ tad api nīvaraṇaṃ yad api kukkuccaṃ tad api nīvaraṇam
sn46.52:9.9: Uddhacca kukkucca nīvaraṇan ti iti hidam uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 18.
sn46.52:9.10: Yad api bhikkhave ajjhattam dhammesu vicikicchā tad api nīvaraṇaṃ || yad api bāhiddhā dhammesu vicikicchā tad api nīvaraṇam
sn46.52:9.11: Vicikicchānīvaraṇan ti Iti hidam uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 19.
sn46.52:9.12: Ayam kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma pañca nīvaraṇā dasa honti || || 20.
sn46.52:10.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma satta bojjhaṅgā catuddasa honti || || 21.
sn46.52:10.2: Yad api bhikkhave ajjhattam dhammesu sati tad api satisambojjhaṅgo || yad api bahiddhā dhammesu sati tad api satisambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:10.3: Satisambojjhaṅgo ti iti hidam uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 22.
sn46.52:11.1: Yad api bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ dhammesu paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsam āpajjati tad api dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo || || Yad api bahiddhā dhammesu paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsam āpajjati || tad api dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:11.2: Dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo ti iti hidam uddesaṃ āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 23.
sn46.52:12.1: Yad api bhikkhave kāyikaṃ viriyaṃ tad api viriyasambojjhaṅgo || yad api cetasikaṃ viriyaṃ tad api viriyasambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:12.2: Viriyasambojjhaṅgo ti iti hidam uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 24.
sn46.52:13.1: Yad api bhikkhave savitakkasavicārā pīti tad api pītisambojjhaṅgo || yad api avitakka avicārā pīti tad api pītisambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:13.2: Pītisambojjhaṅgo ti iti hidam uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam parīyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 25.
sn46.52:14.1: Yad api bhikkhave kāyapassaddhi tad api passaddhisambojjhaṅgo || yad api cittapassaddhi tad api passaddhisambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:14.2: Passaddhisambojjhaṅgo ti iti hidam uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayam hoti || || 26.
sn46.52:15.1: Yad api bhikkhave savitakko savicāro samādhi tad api samādhisambojjhaṅgo || yad api avitakko avicāro samādhi tad api samādhisambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:15.2: Samādhisambojjhaṅgo ti iti hi uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 27.
sn46.52:16.1: Yad api bhikkhave ajjhattam dhammesu upekhā tad api upekhāsambojjhaṅgo || yad api bahiddhā dhammesu upekhā tad api upekhāsambojjhaṅgo Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:16.2: ti iti hidam uddesam āgacchati || tad aminā petam pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti || || 28.
sn46.52:16.3: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave pariyāyo || yam pariyāyam āgamma satta bojjhaṅgā catuddasā
